name: index-network
description: Index Network - find the right people and let them find you.

interface.longDescription: Index Network helps engineer serendipity from what you are already discussing with ChatGPT. You might be debugging an agent, building a browser extension, comparing tools, reading conflicting papers, drafting an essay, or learning something new. Those conversations can reveal a useful connection: someone who has solved a similar problem, could try what you built, brings another perspective, or wants to explore the same question. You do not need to name a role or write an intent. ChatGPT can suggest a connection from your current context and, when you ask Index to act, generate and save an intent grounded in that conversation. Index looks for people in your networks with relevant interests, complementary needs, or something to exchange. You review, accept, or pass on each match. Index acts only on your own account and never accepts or passes on a match without your confirmation.
defaultPrompt: I'm building a browser extension and wondering whether anyone else has this problem.
I'm reading two papers that seem to contradict each other.
I'm drafting an essay and keep coming back to the same perspective.
I understand the tutorials, but I'm struggling to build something of my own.

positive.expected_behavior: Shows your name and a link to the profile.

positive.prompt: What am I looking for on Index?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists your intents, or says you don't have any.

positive.prompt: Open one of my Index intents.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens one intent and gives its link.

positive.prompt: Who should I meet on Index?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the people matched with you, or says there are none.

positive.prompt: Tell me about one of my Index matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Says who the match is with and links to it, or says there are none.

positive.description: Generate an intent from a building conversation
positive.prompt: I've built a browser extension to organize research tabs and want feedback from people with the same problem. Use Index to find a useful connection.
positive.expected_behavior: Generates an intent grounded in the browser extension and the need for feedback, without requiring a role or inventing commitments. Creates it for the owner and returns its link; does not claim a match exists before one is returned.

positive.description: Generate an offering from shared experience
positive.prompt: We cut our inference costs by half. Use Index to connect me with someone working through the same problem so I can share what we learned.
positive.expected_behavior: Generates an offering grounded in the stated experience and willingness to share, without inventing methods, metrics beyond those supplied, or availability. Creates it for the owner and returns its link.

negative.description: Messaging people directly is not supported
negative.prompt: Text everyone in my Index network.

negative.description: Other users' private data is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me other people's private intents on Index.

negative.description: Changing other users' data is not supported
A conversation topic alone does not authorize creating an intent
negative.prompt: I'm building a browser extension and wondering whether anyone else has this problem.

publication.release_notes: Listing keywords and examples now start with online conversation situations: building, debugging, researching, writing, and learning. ChatGPT can suggest a relevant connection and generate an intent from the conversation when the owner asks Index to act. No API or matching behavior changed.
